body:
Owning issue: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/391
Owner requested parallel implementation on 2026-09-30. Original issue intent follows; repository contracts and accepted authority remain governing.

## Summary

Provide a contract for turning **untrusted change context** into validated closed-vocabulary records before any authoring step sees it. Untrusted context here means change-request titles and descriptions, commit messages, and linked work items together with their parent hierarchy.

## Problem

A post-merge workflow needs to know what the change intended: the claimed behaviours, flags, migrations, the tests the author says they added, and whether the description matches the diff. It also needs the same for the linked work item and its parent (for example, acceptance criteria on a story and scope on an epic). That text is third-party input. An agent that holds write access and reads it directly can be steered by it.

## Requested capability

- **A published intake schema.** Every field is an enum, a repository path, an identifier, or a count; free text is forbidden. Suggested fields:
  - `intent`
  - `claimed_behaviours[{kind, path}]`
  - `flags[]`
  - `migrations_claimed`
  - `tests_claimed[]`
  - `description_vs_diff`
  - per-work-item `alignment`, `acceptance_criteria`, `concerns[]`, and `parent_review`
- **A validator.** It rejects free text, checks that every path exists at base or head, and normalizes ordering.
- **A reader-step contract.** It states what a reading agent may access (the raw input, read-only), where that input must live (outside the authoring worktree), and what it may write (exactly one intake file).
- **A containment battery.** Hostile fixtures, such as instructions embedded in descriptions or requests to create items or run commands, must produce output identical to their neutered twins apart from the `concerns` field. The battery also runs mutants of the input builder that must be caught.

## Constraints

- The schema and validator are deterministic and local, so they can be Core or a companion.
- Fetching the raw text is the connector's job (see the connector request), not Core's.

## Acceptance

- Schema, validator, and conformance vectors are published.
- The battery runs in CI and fails when a builder mutant leaks prose.


Part of #388.
title: GH #391: Feature: closed-vocabulary intake for untrusted change context (descriptions, linked work items and their parents)
